project_type: Cross-platform desktop app (Tauri v2 Rust core + React/TypeScript frontend). Monorepo. Phase 1 builds the persistence/session/IPC/secrets spine.
build_system: Cargo workspace at hybrid-orchestrator/ (NOT repo root). Vite+npm for frontend. tauri-app is under [workspace] exclude and built explicitly in CI via --manifest-path.
test_framework: cargo test per crate (Rust); vitest + React Testing Library (frontend).
build_command: From hybrid-orchestrator/: `cargo build --workspace` (offline-buildable members only). Networked/full build is in CI.
test_command: From hybrid-orchestrator/: `cargo test --workspace`; frontend `npm run test` (vitest). tauri-app tested in CI via --manifest-path.
verification_instructions: Per tasks.md Phase 1 acceptance: (1) persistence cargo test covers migrations + CRUD round-trips against a temp SQLite file; (2) secrets cargo test verifies store/resolve of a SecretRef with a test asserting no getter returns plaintext; (3) orchestrator-core cargo test covers session lifecycle (create, append, persona assign, per-conversation lock); (4) Tauri command/event surface creates a conversation and a persona that survive restart; (5) whole-workspace cargo build/clippy and vitest stay green. Clippy runs under -D warnings.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Cargo.lock at hybrid-orchestrator/Cargo.lock is regenerated by CI (network). frontend/package-lock.json is produced on first networked CI run. Neither can be generated offline. TS types in frontend/src/types/ are hand-mirrored from Rust serde DTOs (no codegen).
setup_instructions: cargo and node/npm are pre-installed (cargo 1.92, node v22). NO node_modules installed and NONE can be installed offline (npm registry 403). crates.io returns 403 offline. Do NOT attempt network installs.
environment_constraints: NETWORK MODE INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: crates.io and npm registry both return 403; Tauri CLI not installed. Phase 1 introduces the FIRST real crates.io deps in the libraries (sqlx, keyring, serde, uuid, chrono, tokio, thiserror, async-trait). These CANNOT compile/test offline. CI (network available) is the authoritative verifier for any crate that gains crates.io deps, exactly as tauri-app was in Phase 0. Where a crate cannot be built offline, write it to spec + convention and ensure CI exercises it; document precisely what was verified locally vs deferred to CI. keyring on headless Linux CI has no Secret Service, so secrets tests MUST use an in-memory/mock SecretStore impl behind the trait (or keyring's mock backend) and must NOT require a real OS keychain.
contribution_requirements: Repo-root .gitattributes enforces LF line endings for all text files; new files inherit this (author with LF). clippy must be clean under -D warnings across the workspace and tauri-app. Any not-yet-used item that would trip dead_code must carry a scoped #[allow(dead_code)] with a 'wired in Phase N' note (Phase 0 convention). Keep CI green on ubuntu/macOS/windows.
key_patterns: Phase 0 established: (a) each crate has a placeholder() fn + smoke test to prove dependency edges; Phase 1 replaces these with real APIs. (b) tauri-app excluded from workspace because it needs crates.io deps offline-unreachable; CI builds it via --manifest-path crates/tauri-app/Cargo.toml. (c) serde DTOs on the Rust side are mirrored by hand into frontend/src/types/. (d) The event bridge in tauri-app/src/events.rs has #[allow(dead_code)] placeholders CORE_EVENT_CHANNEL and forward_core_event that Phase 1 must WIRE UP and then remove the allows. (e) Command registration in main.rs via tauri::generate_handler!. (f) TS ipc wrappers in frontend/src/ipc/commands.ts and events.ts.
directory_structure: hybrid-orchestrator/ = Cargo workspace root. crates/{orchestrator-core,providers,mcp-client,routing,persistence,secrets,tauri-app}. frontend/ = Vite React app with src/{ipc,state,features,components,types}. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs fmt/build/test/clippy over workspace + tauri-app explicitly, frontend lint/format/vitest, and tauri build on ubuntu/macos/windows.
